build_probes_dict_from_spec: build a probes dictionary from a CLRS spec by calling probing.initialize with the spec object
convert_predecessor_pointers_to_permutat: convert predecessor pointers array to a permutation matrix using predecessor_pointers_to_permutation_matrix
convert_permutation_matrix_to_predecesso: convert a permutation matrix back to predecessor pointers using permutation_matrix_to_predecessor_pointers
convert_predecessor_to_cyclic_predecesso: convert predecessor pointers to cyclic predecessor and first node mask using predecessor_to_cyclic_predecessor_and_first
split_probes_into_data_points: split a finalized probes dictionary into input output and hint DataPoint lists using split_stages
